tools.name: population_compile
tools.description: Inspect diagnostic SQL, plan-v2 and the bound definition/snapshot hashes without executing. Observation tuple identity differs from referenced User identity. User is referent-only. Same list encoding as population_query; empty metrics selects objects and requires empty dimensions. Diagnostic SQL needs an internal AST dependency and cannot be replayed as ordinary SQL. A separate call after operator reload may bind a different snapshot; compare the execution envelope hashes, including empty results.

tools.name: population_query
tools.description: Aggregate a discovered queryable observation concept. Read concepts-v2, metrics, fields and capabilities first. User is referent-only. Only discovered date/product fields may group. Distinct User count means at least one qualifying observation within the requested scope; it cannot be added across groups. Observation AVG divides by nonnull observation amounts, not Users. Only registered metric expressions are supported. Lists are JSON-encoded string arrays. Result is a single result_json carrier: parse ossie-population-result-v1 columns and row arrays. Integer/Decimal cells are exact strings, IEEE float cells are approximate strings with explicit non-finite values; NULL stays null. Check snapshot hashes even for empty results. Groups are sparse, unsorted and unpaged; combined requests bind separately.

tools.name: population_objects
tools.description: List observations in an exact discovered queryable concept. Read concepts-v2: User is referent-only and cannot be queried. Identity is the ordered typed User/date/product tuple; no synthetic record id. filters is a JSON-encoded array of predicate strings; use "[]" for none. Filters only narrow the formal rule. Result is a single result_json carrier: parse it as ossie-population-result-v1 with bound column types and row arrays. Numeric cells are strings, NULL stays null. Results are unsorted and unpaged; even empty results carry snapshot hashes.
